Phase 77 impl @ 9946059 (branch phase-77-panel-turn-notice, 2 commits on 1c3cc82).
What changed:
- tagteam/panel.py: run_panel(..., notify=None). One guarded call right after the claim log line: 'Panel reviewing <phase> <type> r<N> (<lenses>). The <Reviewer> pane is not used for this turn.' A raising notifier is logged and ignored.
- tagteam/watcher.py: _maybe_panel passes notify=notify_macos; on merged it calls _notify_panel_verdict ('Panel: <decision> on <phase> <type> r<N>. Turn is <Lead>'s.' / 'Cycle approved.' / 'Waiting on the arbiter.' for ESCALATE and NEED_HUMAN), best-effort, and only when the result carries a decision. Start banner gains the pane line in iterm2/terminal/tmux only.
- Contract: one sentence plus the fallback exception in both SKILL.md copies (byte-identical); vendored_contract_hashes.json regenerated (second commit).
Your plan notes: banner cycle names come from panel.on ('/'.join); the contract sentence keeps the ordinary-reviewer fallback exception; the verdict notice is in a try/except.
Beyond the plan text: the verdict notice also covers ESCALATE/NEED_HUMAN, since 'Turn is <Lead>'s' would be wrong there.
Tests (tests/test_panel.py, class TestPanelTurnNotice, 21 cases): once per claimed attempt; zero on not-ready, stale, not-applicable, deferred, already-decided; raising notifier leaves PanelResult and the row unchanged; manual 'panel run' passes no notifier; watcher merged notifies once per verdict, fallback/undecided/decision-less merged do not; live iterm2 tick raises both notices and sends nothing to the pane; banner per mode; contract sentence in both copies.
Five existing watcher-panel tests asserted notify_macos was never called as a proxy for 'reviewer not dispatched'; they now filter the panel's own notices through _dispatches() and still assert zero dispatches.
Verified: focused runs only (test_panel 83 passed; test_watcher, test_watchlog, test_plugin, test_framework pass after the hash commit). Full suite: the gate's run on this submission.
Not verified: success criterion 6 (real notification on QA) is post-merge arbiter acceptance; notify_macos itself was mocked throughout.

GATE: PASS | scope 6 paths | plan-doc ok | tests ok (2713 passed, 5 skipped, 6m04s)
